scope: First 20000 rows in frozen v54 corpus order; exploratory error analysis, not a full language audit
observations: 8346 of 12619 sampled false negatives contain more than 25% non-ASCII letters; many sampled examples are Japanese.
Sampled misses include punctuation-obfuscated Japanese, short link-only bodies, and ads padded with unrelated reference text.
Some CJK-adjacent URLs did not appear in the existing URL_HOSTS field.
HTML-derived bodies can retain CSS declarations after tag removal.
v55Changes: Unicode char 2-5 features for subject and head; separate compact body channel.
CJK punctuation normalization, inline URL detection, removal of CSS and variable tracking paths/recipients.
New archive families partitioned into TRAIN, selection, calibration and engineering test.
FP budget uses ham count; evaluation excludes TRAIN families and compares v54 on the identical new holdout.
limitations: The 500k corpus was already examined in v54; reuse is an engineering comparison, not new independent evidence.
